tokens.text: // The hexatonic cycle, `P L P L P L`, and what it does not do.
// Each transformation is a function from the triad refinement to itself, so
// the cycle is written as an ordinary chain and nothing here is a keyword.
// Six steps return a triad that sounds like the one the cycle began on, and
// is not it: `dbb` major is spelled from D and C major is spelled from C.
// `returned_is_c_major` below is absent for exactly that reason, while
// `returned_classes` and `tonic_classes` are one set. A finite-group claim
// is true after the projection and not before, and both halves are values
// Nothing in `std::transformational` chooses a register: a chord class is not
// music, and a triad is not either. The bass pitch under every chord below is
// written by this piece, which is the only place that knows what it wants to
// The triad refinement is the domain, and this `option` is the proof of
// membership. A seventh chord or a suspension has no answer here, which
// is why the transformations never have to check.
// The six waypoints. Each is written as the chain that reaches it, so
// the path is in the source rather than in a comment.
// Two voicing policies. Each takes its bass and its triad together; the
// `triad -> music` a fold wants is written where it is wanted, with the
// bass of that chord closed over.
// The cycle in close position. The bass under each chord is a pitch of
// that chord's own spelling — `ab3` under the A flat triads, `fb3` under
// the F flat ones — because a voicing is spelled or it does not exist.
// The same six under drop-2, which is the same chord classes and a
// different sound: the policy is the caller's, never the library's.
// Reach a waypoint, then voice it. Written out because a composition of
// two functions is a function and this language has no operator for it.
// What the cycle returned, asked two ways.
// The first is a spelling question: a voicing from `c4` exists only if
// `c` is a member of the class as written, and after six steps it is
// not. The second is a pitch-class question, and there the cycle closed.
// The named compositions, on the triad OMT names them from.
